# Local visualization runtime

These browser bundles are stored locally so replay does not depend on a CDN:

- Vega 5.33.0 (`vega.min.js`)
- Vega-Lite 5.23.0 (`vega-lite.min.js`)
- Vega-Embed 6.29.0 (`vega-embed.min.js`)

They were obtained from the corresponding npm packages through jsDelivr. The
projects are distributed under BSD-3-Clause licenses. See their upstream
repositories for source and license text:

- https://github.com/vega/vega
- https://github.com/vega/vega-lite
- https://github.com/vega/vega-embed
